component.name: KeyItem
component.script: sub onContent() t = m.top.itemContent.title l = m.top.findNode("lbl") l.text = t if t.len() > 3 then l.font.size = 17 end sub sub onFocus() on = m.top.gridHasFocus and m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 if on then m.top.findNode("bg").color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.top.findNode("lbl").color = "0x0A0A0AFF" else m.top.findNode("bg").color = "0x1E1F21FF" m.top.findNode("lbl").color = "0xE1E3E6FF" end if end sub
